text:
mia: Quick design question — the Batch Inspector's vectors preview sidebar feels cramped when the relevance table is open. Can we explore a wider right panel? :thinking:

diego: Agree. Current width is 320px; I propose bumping to 420px. Any constraints for small screens we should keep in mind?

lex: 420px seems reasonable on desktop. On <640px we should collapse to a bottom drawer. Accessibility nits: ensure a focus trap and a skip link when it opens. :accessibility:  

sam: Figma frames updated: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz — added 420px and an inline popover variant. PTAL and leave comments.

mia: Two small copy nits: header should read "Vectors preview" (plural) not "Vector preview", and the export CTA should be "Export selection" rather than just "Export" — clearer for batch workflows.

diego: +1 on copy. Also, when reranking is applied, we should show a subtle badge "Reranked" with a clear affordance to revert to original order. Otherwise people might assume results are immutable.

lex: Proposed microcopy for the badge: "Reranked by model (v2) — view original". Keeps it short and actionable.

sam: Accessibility detail: screen readers should announce "Vectors preview, dialog" when the sidebar opens. Right now we use role="complementary" which may not be announced as a dialog. Suggest role="dialog" with aria-modal="true" and aria-labelledby pointing to the header id.

mia: Good call. Also can we add a keyboard shortcut to toggle the preview? 'K' to open the selected item preview would be nice for power users. Not blocking but high-value.

diego: Quick CSS prototype to start with:
```
.batch-inspector__sidebar { width: 420px; max-width: 45vw; }
@media (max-width: 640px) { .batch-inspector__sidebar { width: 100%; bottom: 0; position: fixed; } }
```

sam: I'll add the aria attributes and focus-trap notes to the Figma prototype comments. Assigning diego for implementation, lex for final copy, and mia to sign off on the UX. :thumbsup:

aria-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled Tue 11:00 AM — invite added.

diego: I'll prototype the CSS and open a PR with screenshots and the accessibility checklist. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

mia: Perfect. One more small thing: for the export flow, show a confirmation toast like "Export started — we'll email you when ready" so people don't keep clicking.

sam: Noted and added to ticket #4567.
